verdict.rationale: Amplitude AI lets users ask plain-language questions and get answers across their data, and an embeddable agent can 'answer questions, guide flows, and complete tasks for users,' which shows some built-in delegatable AI assistant capability. However, evidence is limited to marketing docs snippets with no hands-on demonstration of task delegation scope, autonomy limits, or independent corroboration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI assistant actually completing delegated tasks, detail on task scope/autonomy, and confirmation this is available to the analytics-user persona (not just embedded end-user product).
